page_title: CRY 1-1 NEW | Crystal Palace v Newcastle 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Oliver Glasner appears to have said too much and referee Darren England comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.

90+4' 1 - 1 Marc Guehi showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:1.
90+3' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren England blows for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
88' The referee gives a yellow card to Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
87' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
87' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
86' The resulting corner from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
85' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
84' Trevoh Chalobah will be replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
81' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
80' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) brings an opponent down and Darren England interrupts the game.
77' That will be all from Will Hughes who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
77' Total attempts – 15:2.
76' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Joe Willock is replaced by Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
75' Anthony Gordon comes off the pitch to be replaced by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
74' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
74' Crystal Palace will take a corner kick.
74' Nick Pope pulls off a great save to deny Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
70' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
70' The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
67' Crystal Palace get a corner.
67' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
65' Eberechi Eze goes off the pitch and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) comes on.
64' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
62' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
62' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.
59' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
59' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) and blew his whistle.
55' The game is interrupted as Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is flagged offside.
54' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
53' 0 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) puts the ball into his own net.
53' Newcastle are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
52' Darren England blows his whistle after Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
51' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
50' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
48' A cross into the box from Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
46' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is penalised for holding. Darren England signals a set piece.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Darren England blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
45+4' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
45+3' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
45+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) will take a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
44' Flag goes up against Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
43' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
43' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
43' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

40' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
39' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
38' Some patient build-up play from Newcastle as they look to unlock the defence.
36' CHANCE! Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Ismaila Sarr.
35' The resulting corner, taken by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), comes to nothing.
32' The free kick picks out Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the left post.
31' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
30' The linesman raises his flag. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.
29' Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
26' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:0.
23' Darren England blows his whistle. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play.
22' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Harvey Barnes.
21' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is able to continue to play.
20' The game is interrupted now, Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
17' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
16' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
14' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' A spell of possession for Newcastle in an attempt to control the game.
10' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Nick Pope comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Darren England blows his whistle after Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
8' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
4' Darren England interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).

3' Crystal Palace hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
